other_conditions: Total family income less than ₹10,000 per month in rural areas and less than ₹12,000 per month in urban areas.
Total family land holding less than 3 acres of wet land or less than 10 acres of dry land (or combined 10 acres) for the purpose.
No family member should be a government employee or pensioner (except families of sanitary workers are exempted).
Family should not own a four-wheeler (taxi, tractor, auto are exempted).
Monthly electricity consumption of the dwelling unit should be less than 300 units.
No family member should be an income tax payer.
Built-up area of municipal property should be less than 750 square feet (residential or commercial).
Applicant must belong to the Kapu community (Kapu, Balija, Telaga, or Ontari).
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹75,000 over 5 years (₹15,000 per annum).
